summary: The PR addresses an issue with file upload permissions but lacks documentation and may introduce behavioral changes.

issues.description: The PR does not address the issue of inconsistent permissions between MemoryUploadedFile and TemporaryUploadedFile, which could still occur.
Changing the default permission to 0o644 may break existing deployments that rely on the current behavior of inheriting system defaults or using custom handlers.
There is no update to the documentation to reflect the change in default file upload permissions.
